title: Extension build
description: Builds the Blender extension archives the member's blender_manifest.toml declares, from its folder or from a staged copy bundling its locked dependencies as wheels

outputPath.description: Workspace-relative folder the archives are written to, one per configuration so a release build never overwrites the default one

bundle.description: Stages the extension with its locked third-party wheels for the running Blender's platform, minus what that Blender bundles, and its workspace dependencies built as wheels
